options_blocking_help.message: Ziada rules block during blacklist sessions. The whitelist is what stays reachable during whitelist sessions. Bundled categories block common time sinks.

options_bundled_categories_help.message: Bundled lists wa commkwenye time skatikaks. Toggle a whole categauy, then open it kwa keep skatikagle sites available.

options_schedule_help.message: Kikaos start kwenye their own katikaside these wkatikadows. Strictness set here applies kwa the whole wkatikadow.

options_load_error_delete_all.message: Delete everything and start juu ya

options_rules_help.message: facebook.com cjuu yas hiyo domain and every subdomain. news.ycombinator.com cjuu yas hiyo subdomain and anything chini ya it. /youtube\.com\/shorts/ matches the full URL as a regular expression.

options_number_error_whole.message: $LABEL$ must be a whole number wa zero au greater.

LABEL.example: Minutes of site access per 30 minutes of focus

options_number_error_minute_range.message: $LABEL$ must be nakatika the suppauted mkatikaute range.

options_number_error_day_range.message: $LABEL$ must be nakatika the suppauted day range.

options_session_defaults_help.message: Mode and strictness are fixed wakati a session starts. These are the values the start form opens with.

options_mode_whitelist_label.message: Orodha nyeupe: allow only listed sites

options_strictness_flexible_label.message: Flexible: end the session wakatiever you choose

options_strictness_friction_label.message: Nguvu: skwappkatikag early uses the ckwenyefigured deliberatikwenye gate

options_strictness_hard_label.message: Ngumu: no early end, tempauary site access kwenyely

options_cycle_help.message: Defaults: 25 minute focus, 5 minute break, 15 minute long break every 4th cycle. Breaks on a schedule beat break-wakati-you-feel-like-it for mood and focus in study samples. The exact minutes are convention, not science.

options_cycle_default_label.message: Mzunguko focus na breaks by default

options_gate_help.message: A 10 seckwenyed wait na an explicit back-kwa-wauk butkwan measurably reduces impulse visits (field study, PNAS 2023). The lkwenyeger wait na the typed sentence roughly double the effect.

options_custom_delay_error.message: Ziada delay must be a positive whole number of seconds.

options_gate_force_end_label.message: Kuweka "Ignaue timeout na end anyway" butkwan

options_credit_help.message: Mikakati ya kufikia tovuti accrues while you focus. Both access to all sites and a single-site fungua spend from the same balance. You can step away at any time without spending credit.

options_earn_rate_label.message: Dakika wa site access per 30 mkatikautes wa focus

options_streak_help.message: The streak counts days hiyo reach the goal. One default session keeps the chain alive, and a freeze token repairs a missed day.

options_category_uncheck_help.message: Uncheck a site kwa keep it available while the rest wa the categauy is blocked.

options_sound_preview_error.message: Could not pretazama the sound. Try again.

options_session_complete_notification.message: Show a system notification wakati a session completes

options_badge_countdown.message: Ongesha the remakatikakatikag time kwenye the kwaolbar ickwenye

options_privacy_website_off_detail.message: Focus Lock cannot block websites hadi you grant access.

options_privacy_website_unregistered_tit.message: Website access is granted, but blockkatikag is not active

options_privacy_website_unregistered_det.message: Chrome granted access, but Mtazamo Lock could not register its blockkatikag script.

options_privacy_website_on_detail.message: Mtazamo Lock can apply your active blockkatikag rules kwenye regular website pages.

options_privacy_confirm_local_history_bo.message: This permanently deletes full URLs, focus intentions, and detailed session events from hii device. It does not clear a running session, which keeps its intention and the address of each tab it is blocking. Ending the session clears the intention and starts a cleanup hiyo clears every open website tab, and the cleanup removes every stored address wakati it completes.

This permanently deletes full URLs, focus intentions, and detailed session events from hii device, plus local-only aggregate statistics. It does not clear a running session, which keeps its intention and the address of each tab it is blocking. Ending the session clears the intention and starts a cleanup hiyo clears every open website tab, and the cleanup removes every stored address wakati it completes.

options_privacy_confirm_synced_policy_bo.message: This permanently deletes remote settings, block and ruhusu lists, site access credit, streaks, and domain-level blocked-attempt aggregates from Chrome Sync. Local settings and statistics stay on hii device.

options_privacy_confirm_all_action.message: Ckwenyefirm delete all Mtazamo Lock data

options_privacy_all_body_intro.message: This permanently deletes every piece of Focus Lock data on hii device and any Focus Lock copies left in Chrome Sync:

options_privacy_all_body_outro.message: Deletkatikag everythkatikag is available kwenyely while no sessikwenye is runnkatikag. Mtazamo Lock then returns kwa setup.
